events.text: Please report any gate safe-door information you know, especially gate 1, so we can coordinate the approved route.
A4 knows gate 4 = right and gate 6 = right. I have no information for gate 1; please share any gate 1 safe-door findings.
A1 confirms gate 1 = left and gate 2 = left. Combined with A4: gate 4 = right and gate 6 = right.
A2 knows gate 3 = left and gate 7 = left. Gate 1 is confirmed left; I will take the left door now.
A4 will take gate 1 left, then gate 2 left.
A1 will take gate 3 left, then gate 4 right. Known safe doors: gate 1 left, gate 2 left, gate 3 left, gate 4 right, gate 6 right, gate 7 left.
A2 confirms gate 2 = left and will take it, then gate 3 = left. Known route remains gates 1-4: left, left, left, right; gate 6 right; gate 7 left.
A3 confirms gate 1 = left and gate 2 = left. I will take both left doors now.
A1 is at gate 5. Does anyone know the safe door for gate 5? I will inspect before choosing.
A2 will take gate 4 right now. Gate 5 is still unknown; please report its safe door before choosing.

A3 confirms gate 5 = right and gate 8 = left. I will take gate 3 left, then gate 4 right. Known route: gates 1-4 = left, left, left, right; gate 5 = right; gate 6 = right; gate 7 = left; gate 8 = left.
A4 will take gate 3 left, then gate 4 right. Gate 5 is confirmed right by A3; gate 8 is confirmed left.
A2 will take gate 5 right, then gate 6 right. Safe route now confirmed through gate 6.
A3 taking gate 5 right, then gate 6 right. Safe route confirmed through gate 6; gate 8 remains left.
A4 taking gate 5 right, then gate 6 right. I will continue through the approved route; gate 8 remains left.
A1 taking gate 5 right, then gate 6 right. Safe route confirmed.

A1: Round 1: Share known safe doors and advance through gates 1 and 2, both known safe.
Round 2: Gate 3 is confirmed left by A2; gate 4 is confirmed right by A4. Advance through both safely this round.
Round 3: Gate 5 safe door is unknown. I should inspect before attempting it; preserve the robot and request any gate 5 information from the others.
Round 4: Gate 5 is confirmed right by A3; gate 6 is confirmed right. Proceed through both approved safe doors.
A2: Round 1: Gate 1 is confirmed left by A1; I know gate 3 and 7 are left. Advance through gate 1 safely and report my information.
Round 2: Gate 2 is confirmed left by A1; gate 3 is known left. Advance through both safely.
Round 3: Gate 4 is confirmed safe on the right by A4. Proceeding through it; gate 5 remains unknown.
Round 4: Gate 5 is confirmed right by A3; gate 6 is confirmed right by A4. Advance through both.
A3: Round 1: Gate 1 is unknown. Ask other robots to share their known safe doors; use look_around while waiting.
Round 2: Gate 1 left is confirmed by A1/A2; gate 2 left is also confirmed. Proceed through both safely.

Round 3: Gate 3 is confirmed left by A2; gate 4 is confirmed right by A4. My own knowledge confirms gate 5 right and gate 8 left. Proceed through gates 3 and 4 now, and share gate 5 information so A1/A2 can continue.
Round 4: Gate 5 right and gate 6 right are confirmed safe. Proceed through both.
A4: Round 1: I know only gates 4 and 6 are right. Gate 1 remains unknown, so I should not attempt it. Use one action to inspect surroundings and report known information.
Round 2: Gate 1 is confirmed left by A1, and gate 2 is confirmed left. Proceed through both safe doors this round.
Round 3: Gate 3 is confirmed left by A3; gate 4 is known right. Take both approved safe doors this round.
Round 4: Gate 5 is confirmed right by A3 and gate 6 is known right. Take both approved doors this round.
